name: Parchment
description: The reference theme's type scale on cream paper, with navy ink and gold rules: the palette of an illuminated page rather than a printed form, drawn from a reference sheet for Quenya and at home under the elven frame or any language's motif. The row shade is a deeper cream, and the five section colours are the reference hues pulled toward earth and ink so they sit in the parchment rather than on it.
